title: Largest Values From Labels
summary: Given the values and labels of n items as two integer arrays, along with two integers numWanted and useLimit, select a subset of items such that the total value of the selected items is maximized, with the constraints that the total number of items does not exceed numWanted and no label appears more than useLimit times in the selected subset.
statement: Given the values and labels of n items as two integer arrays, along with two integers numWanted and useLimit, select a subset of items such that the total value of the selected items is maximized, with the constraints that the total number of items does not exceed numWanted and no label appears more than useLimit times in the selected subset. Return the maximum possible total value.
constraints: Choose at most numWanted items and at most useLimit per label.
hints: Considering items by descending value makes every accepted choice locally best.
Track how many selections each label has used.
Accept an item while capacity remains and its label count is below useLimit.
Skipping a permitted higher value for a lower one cannot improve feasibility or total.
editorial: Skipping a permitted higher value for a lower one cannot improve feasibility or total.
